Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
Political Struggle
+1 stealth action.

Ⓓ Put this card on a ready vampire controlled by another Methuselah. The acting vampire can enter combat with the attached vampire as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. If the attached vampire is burned or sent to torpor, this card is burned and the acting vampire gets +X votes, where X is the number of non-contested votes this vampire has.

What happen if victim priscus? if gain ballot acting vampire?
And what happen if vampire has title(example Eze, The Demon Prince-magaji) and his text say him have 1 additional vote,if acting vampire get 3 votes total?(2 for magaji and +1 additional vote by Eze special)

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> beslin wrote:
> Political Struggle
> +1 stealth action.
>
> Ⓓ Put this card on a ready vampire controlled by another Methuselah. The acting vampire can enter combat with the attached vampire as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. If the attached vampire is burned or sent to torpor, this card is burned and the acting vampire gets +X votes, where X is the number of non-contested votes this vampire has.
>
> What happen if victim priscus? if gain ballot acting vampire?
>
No. Votes only (in this case 0 vote).

> beslin wrote:
> And what happen if vampire has title(example Eze, The Demon Prince-magaji) and his text say him have 1 additional vote,if acting vampire get 3 votes total?(2 for magaji and +1 additional vote by Eze special)
>
Yes, 3 votes, since the +1 vote he gets is unconditional.
